contact.about: Lauco Experience was created to promote the routes and trails of our area. Interactive maps, photos, videos and downloadable tracks offer an immersive way to discover Lauco’s natural landscape.

contribute.intro: Lauco Experience can grow thanks to residents, hikers, associations and people who know the area. You can send useful material to improve pages, places, tracks and published information.

home.about: Discover the trails, history and nature of the Lauco Plateau
home.contribute_body: Send photos, descriptions, tracks, points of interest or useful information to enrich the website and tell the story of Lauco more fully.
home.help_body: Even a small contribution can help: a report, a photograph, a day spent clearing paths, an on-site check or a route update all make Lauco Experience more useful, accurate and connected to the area.
home.report_body: Report errors, impassable sections, signage problems, obstacles, route changes or information that needs correcting or updating.
home.report_title: Contributions and reports help keep Lauco Experience useful, accurate and up to date.

legacy.services.0349d102b8: Before going on a hike, pack a backpack with water, snacks, map or GPS, waterproof jacket and first aid kit. Wear comfortable hiking shoes and layered clothing: the weather can change quickly in the mountains. Bring a hat and sunscreen. Always find out about the route, follow the signs and notify someone of your destination. Avoid venturing alone on little-known trails. Respect nature.
legacy.services.f55fc01ae3: Discover the landscapes, woods, meadows and peaks that make our territory unique. From scenic trails to walks among flowers and waterfalls, each route tells a story. Observe the fauna, breathe the clean air and enjoy the peace of the places. Suitable for everyone, our itineraries enhance direct contact with the environment.
